name: gcd_
description: Exact native schema aten::gcd_(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor other) -> Tensor(a!). Compute elementwise greatest common divisor on integer tensors in place, mutating self and returning the same tensor alias. other is read-only; broadcasting must be compatible with in-place destination shape. Existing master tests compare values for pointwise integer inputs; they do not explicitly assert mutation or return identity. The repaired test suite additionally verifies return identity, self metadata/storage preservation and exact preservation of other, while retaining the original numeric assertion.
